name: TPS54560B
description: 60 V, 5 A non-synchronous buck with Eco-mode, for powering servos or an SBC from 24–48 V robot batteries.
notes: Non-synchronous: needs an external 60 V, 5 A Schottky diode.
RT resistor sets 100 kHz–2.5 MHz (500 kHz with 200 kΩ); external compensation on COMP.

en.note: Internal pull-up I1 = 1.2 µA (float = enabled) plus Ihys = 3.4 µA sourced when EN > 1.2 V. Threshold 1.2 V (1.1-1.3). Abs max 8.4 V, so never tie to VIN. The typical app µses a UVLO divider: RUVLO1 = 442k (VIN-EN), RUVLO2 = 90.9k (EN-GND) for 6.5 V start / 5 V stop. Eq.4 RUVLO1 = (VSTART - VSTOP)/Ihys; Eq.5 RUVLO2 = VENA / ((VSTART - VENA)/RUVLO1 + I1). Use a zener clamp if EN could exceed 8.4 V at high VIN. For always-on, leave EN floating.

comp.note: gmea = 350 µA/V (EA transconductance, normal operation; 77 µA/V in timing table / 78 µA/V in text during soft-start). gmps = 17 A/V (COMP-to-SW current transconductance, EC p5). EA dc gain 10,000 V/V, min unity-gain BW 2500 kHz, source/sink +/-30 µA. Datasheet method (Sec 8.2.2.11, Type 2A: R4 in series with C5 COMP to GND, optional C8 COMP to GND): Eq.44 fp(mod) = IOUT(max) / (2 pi x VOUT x COUT); Eq.45 fz(mod) = 1 / (2 pi x RESR x COUT); Eq.46 fco1 = sqrt(fp(mod) x fz(mod)); Eq.47 fco2 = sqrt(fp(mod) x fSW/2); the datasheet says to µse the geometric mean of Eq.46 and Eq.47 as the initial fco (the TPS54360 sheet says the lower one); Eq.48 R4 = (2 pi x fco x COUT / gmps) x (VOUT / (VREF x gmea)); Eq.49 C5 = 1 / (2 pi x R4 x fp(mod)); Eq.50 C8 = COUT x RESR / R4; Eq.51 C8 = 1 / (R4 x fSW x pi); µse the larger for C8 (optional pole). Use derated COUT. The method ignores slope compensation and assumes fz >= 10 x fp. Example (5 V, 5 A, 400 kHz, COUT 3x47 µF derated to 87.4 µF, RESR 1.67 mOhm): fp 1821 Hz, fz 1100 kHz, fco1 44.6 kHz, fco2 19.1 kHz, fco raised to 30 kHz after lab measurement (29.2 kHz µsed in Eq.48), R4 = 16.9k (16.8 calc), C5 = 4700 pF (5172 calc), C8 = 47 pF. Type 1 and Type 2B networks are also supported (Fig 30).

extras.note: A resistor is required (no default frequency). Eq.7: RT(kΩ) = 101756 / fSW(kHz)^1.008 gives 193.6k for 500 kHz, so µse E96 196k (Eq.8 fSW = 92417 / RT^0.991 gives about 494 kHz). The EC table specifies RT = 200k as 500 kHz typ (450-550). Range 100-2500 kHz. Check fSW against the min-on-time pulse-skip and foldback equations (Eq.9/10, Eq.25/26). Sync range 160-2300 kHz.

notes: Asynchronous: external Schottky catch diode SW to GND. Peak-current-mode, external compensation on COMP. Same pinout as TPS54360, but gmps = 17 A/V (not 12) and current limit 7.9 A typ.
Internal soft-start: tSS(ms) = 1024 / fSW(kHz) (Eq.6), 2.1 ms at 500 kHz (10-90%). No SS pin.
RHS = RLS x (VOUT - 0.8 V)/0.8 V (Eq.3/42). The example µses RLS = 10.2k, RHS = 53.6k for 5 V. Divider current must be > 1 µA, so RLS < 800 kΩ.

Inductor: LO(min) = (VIN(max) - VOUT)/(IOUT x KIND) x VOUT/(VIN(max) x fSW) (Eq.28). KIND up to 0.3 for ceramics, 0.2 for higher-ESR caps. Ripple must stay > 150 mA. Conservative: Isat >= switch current limit (text says 'nominally 7.5 A' while the EC typ is 7.9 A).
COUT criteria: Eq.32 COUT > 2 x dIOUT/(fSW x dVOUT); Eq.33 COUT > LO x (IOH^2 - IOL^2)/(Vf^2 - Vi^2); Eq.34 COUT > 1/(8 fSW) x 1/(VORIPPLE/IRIPPLE); Eq.35 RESR < VORIPPLE/IRIPPLE. Use derated values.

Design example (Fig. 32) is at 400 kHz, not 500 kHz: 5 V/5 A, VIN 7-60 V, RT 243k, L 7.2 µH (WE 7447798720), COUT 3 x 47 µF 10 V ceramic, CIN 4 x 2.2 µF 100 V, D1 B560C, Cboot 0.1 µF, UVLO 442k/90.9k, FB 53.6k/10.2k, COMP 16.9k + 4700 pF // 47 pF.
Input: X5R/X7R ceramic with at least 3 µF EFFECTIVE, rated above VIN max. The example µses 4 x 2.2 µF 100 V (8.8 µF).
BOOT: 0.1 µF X5R or better, >= 10 V. 100% duty while BOOT-SW > 2.1 V (integrated recharge FET, disabled above 24 V output). VIN(min) = (VOUT + VF + Rdc x IOUT)/0.99 - VF + RDS(on) x IOUT (Eq.1/43).
Current limit 7.9 A typ (6.3 min, 9.5 max, open loop). Min controllable on-time 135 ns typ (text, p14/p25; not in the EC table).
Pulse-skip Eco-mode at light load. Catalog '500 kHz' is not an internal default: RT must be fitted.
